PowerToys#47501 has the same crash: a WPF InvalidOperationException 'Cyclic reference found while evaluating the Style property' on a ListView with 15 items, thrown from ThemeManager.OnSystemThemeChanged. Maintainers triaged it as a PowerToys Run (WPF) problem, triggered when Windows broadcasts a system theme change. parsed.answer: This has been reported before. PowerToys#47501 has the same crash: a WPF InvalidOperationException 'Cyclic reference found while evaluating the Style property' on a ListView with 15 items, thrown from ThemeManager.OnSystemThemeChanged. Maintainers triaged it as a PowerToys Run (WPF) problem, triggered when Windows broadcasts a system theme change. Typical triggers are a theme or accent change, an automatic light/dark switch, or resuming from sleep. A restart after a Windows update can plausibly do the same. That ticket has no confirmed fix or workaround yet. Meanwhile, you can try these steps: update to the latest PowerToys release, and if the crash continues, temporarily disable PowerToys Run or turn off 'Run at startup' to avoid the boot-time crash. If you can, add to #47501 that this happened in a Parallels VM on Windows 11 right after an update and a restart, and attach your bug report. The older tickets PowerToys#37291 (same cyclic Style reference crash on wake from sleep) were closed as duplicates of other issues, and the DwmExtendFrameIntoClientArea 'desktop composition is disabled' tickets are a different exception, so they don't apply here.
